crossRefs.note: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

translations.web: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.
translations.bsb: It is better to heed a wise man’s rebuke than to listen to the song of fools.
